(()=>{const launcher=document.querySelector('.live-assistant-launcher');if(!launcher)throw Error('Live assistant launcher not found');const rect=launcher.getBoundingClientRect();if(rect.width>200)throw Error('Launcher should be compact pill on mobile: '+rect.width);const cta=document.querySelector('.building-preview-cta');if(!cta)throw Error('Preview CTA missing');const ctaRect=cta.getBoundingClientRect();if(rect.top<ctaRect.bottom&&rect.bottom>ctaRect.top&&rect.left<ctaRect.right&&rect.right>ctaRect.left)throw Error('Launcher is occluding Preview CTA button');return {launcher:rect,cta:ctaRect};})()

(()=>{const panel=document.querySelector('#live-assistant-panel');const rect=panel.getBoundingClientRect();if(rect.right>window.innerWidth+2||rect.left<-2)throw Error('Live assistant panel exceeds mobile screen width: '+rect.width);return {width:rect.width};})()

(()=>{const msgs=document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry');if(msgs.length<1)throw Error('Expected chat response in mobile assistant');const status=window.__magicPencil?.getStatus();if(!status||status.mode!=='drawing')throw Error('Draftsman not running: '+JSON.stringify(status));return {status};})()
